payload.reason: The evidence indicates that the Attention-Sum Reader model shows significant improvements when trained on the BookTest dataset compared to the original Children's Book Test dataset.

claims.text: Training on the BookTest dataset improves the accuracy of the Attention-Sum Reader model on the original CBT test data by a much larger margin than many recent attempts to improve the model architecture.
By training on the new dataset, the prediction error is reduced by almost one third, bringing the model's performance to the level of the human baseline on the named-entity version of CBT.
